_comment: VERIFY: official rule — every value in this file is a GST compliance value that changes over time. A human must confirm each against the current GSTN / CBIC notifications and the official GSTR-1 offline-tool schema before filing. The app only reads these; it never hard-codes them.

Gst._B2clThresholdNote: VERIFY: inter-state B2C invoice value above which an invoice is reported individually in GSTR-1 B2CL (was Rs 2,50,000; reduced to Rs 1,00,000 from Aug 2024 — confirm the current figure).
Gst._JsonVersionNote: VERIFY: 'version' string expected by the GSTR-1 offline tool / portal JSON upload at the time of filing.
Gst._StateCodesNote: VERIFY: GST state codes (first two digits of a GSTIN). Keys are matched case-insensitively against the State text on the business / customer.
Gst._UqcNote: VERIFY: Unit Quantity Codes (UQC) used in the GSTR-1 HSN summary. Keys are matched case-insensitively against the product unit's name or short name; anything unmapped is reported as OTH.
